title: History of Mind Mapping: From Porphyry to Buzan to AI (2026)
summary: The sourced history of mind mapping, 270 AD to 2026. Why the Porphyry origin story is wrong, what the evidence really shows, and how AI made concept maps win.
body_markdown:
Increasingly, a view inside a broader workspace. In Taskade a project renders multiple ways, including Mind Map, over one set of nodes, so switching view never means exporting between apps.


---


Porphyry described a method and someone else drew it. Llull built a machine for thinking and nobody could run it. Novak labelled his edges and the machines eventually did. Buzan gave the technique a name, a television series, and the wrong explanation for why it worked — and reached more people than the other three combined.


The lesson that survives all of it is small and durable: **a diagram is only worth what its arrows mean.** Get the relationships right and the picture takes care of itself.
